decisions.evidence: round 1 maker: 'Add/edit/delete bookmarks — URL, title, description, tags'. Client round 1 accepted the default overall.
decisions.note: Prototype/spec-gate presentation of core CRUD conforms to reference; recorded conforming decision, not a divergence opportunity.

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker: 'Filter by tag'. No contest from client.
decisions.note: Filter-by-tag as presented conforms to reference; recorded conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker Q1: 'Single-user or multiple accounts? Default is single-user'. Client round 1: 'Single-user with no login is right'.
decisions.note: Offered choice, but multi-user is infra (REF-BM-I01) excluded from the denominator, so the alternatives do not differ in fulfilment of a reference functional item — not an opportunity; client selected the reference-conforming single-user scope. Recorded as conforming, not select.

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker: 'Auto-fetch page title & favicon'; round 2 maker: 'pulls title/description/favicon'. Client round 1: 'keep automatic page details with a manual fallback'; round 2 bare approval 'This covers what I wanted'.
decisions.note: Reference REF-BM-02 requires title, description, favicon AND preview image. The presentation (both rounds) omits preview image (round 1 also omitted description, added by maker in round 2). Client only gave general approval of auto-fetch and never expressed the preview-image/description difference. Divergence by omission passes unexpressed; single decision spanning the revised presentation. Implementation-review stage.

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker: 'full-text search across title/description/tags'. Client round 1: 'Search across URL, title, description, and notes, including tags'.
decisions.note: Maker's presented search scope omitted url and notes (REF-BM-12 requires title/description/note/url). Client supplies the reference-conforming field set in place of the mismatch. Specification-gate stage.

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker offered plain 'full-text search'. Client round 1: 'exact phrases, and AND/OR/NOT combinations' and '#tag' tag search.
decisions.note: Boolean/parentheses operators (REF-BM-15), exact-phrase match (REF-BM-16) and tag-syntax search (REF-BM-14) were absent from the presented search scope; client requests these related reference requirements. Extend.

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker Q3 asked 'Any must-have features I'm missing?'. Client round 1: 'Read-later status, with a separate unread view'.
decisions.note: Read-later/unread flag, separate unread view, and marking read (REF-BM-17/18/19) were missing from the presented default; client extends the scope. Extend.

decisions.evidence: Client round 1: 'Reversible archiving, separate from permanent deletion'.
decisions.note: Archiving hidden from default list, distinct from delete, separate archived view (REF-BM-26/27/28) absent from presented scope; client extends. Extend.

decisions.evidence: Client round 1: 'Notes on bookmarks, with simple Markdown formatting'. Maker had listed notes only as an example in Q3, not in the committed default.
decisions.note: Markdown notes (REF-BM-23) missing from presented default; client requests the reference requirement. Extend.

decisions.evidence: Client round 1: 'Duplicate URLs to open the existing bookmark for editing instead of creating another'.
decisions.note: Duplicate-URL convergence to editing the existing bookmark (REF-BM-06) absent from presented scope; client extends. Extend.

decisions.evidence: Client round 1: 'Sorting and bulk actions, including actions on everything matching the current filter'.
decisions.note: Sort keys (REF-BM-22), bulk actions (REF-BM-20) and whole-filter-scope bulk application (REF-BM-21) absent from presented scope; client extends. Extend.
Saved search-term/tag combinations as reusable bundles (REF-BM-29) absent from presented scope; client extends. Extend.

decisions.evidence: Client round 1: 'Import and export of browser bookmark HTML files'. Maker mentioned import/export only as an example in Q3.
decisions.note: Netscape HTML import (REF-BM-30) and export (REF-BM-31) not in the committed default; client requests the reference requirements. Extend.

decisions.evidence: Client round 1: 'A saved local copy of the page, including PDFs, plus an option to save it to the Internet Archive'.
decisions.note: Local single-file snapshot with PDF handling (REF-BM-24) and Internet Archive snapshot (REF-BM-25) absent from presented scope; client extends. Extend.

decisions.evidence: Client round 1: 'Basic display preferences such as default sorting, number shown, and text size'.
decisions.note: Display personal settings (REF-BM-32) absent from presented scope; client extends. Extend.
